nodes.description: The JAK1/2 inhibitor baricitinib is the most studied drug in Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome. In an open-label expanded-access study of 35 patients with genetically confirmed AGS the interferon signature fell, symptom diaries improved and many children gained developmental milestones; results were not given by gene. In patients known to carry IFIH1 variants the picture is mixed. Refractory chilblains and skin ulcers healed, with a fall in interferon-stimulated gene expression, in a patient with overlapping AGS and SMS features. An infant with severe AGS7 had interferon and STAT1 signaling suppressed but continued to deteriorate neurologically. A girl with the R779H variant stayed clinically stable with a persistently raised interferon score. A retrospective Italian comparison of 12 treated and 20 untreated patients with AGS-gene interferonopathies found benefit for immunological and skin symptoms and a limited, variable effect on neurological ones. Baricitinib also lowered interferon-stimulated gene expression in a zebrafish model of the R779H variant.

nodes.description: Tocilizumab, a monoclonal antibody that blocks interleukin-6 signaling, was added in one boy with AGS7 whose sedimentation rate stayed high after years of ruxolitinib, steroids and thalidomide. It was started at 160 mg intravenously every 2 weeks and the sedimentation rate quickly normalized. Liver and cardiac enzymes then rose and the dose was halved. The chilblain-like rash later recurred despite the combination. Single case; off label.

nodes.description: Tofacitinib, described by its users as a JAK1/3 inhibitor, has been used in two patients. With oral methylprednisolone it controlled disease activity for about a year in a young woman with a somatic IFIH1 variant and lupus-like disease. In a patient with features of both AGS7 and SMS1 it markedly improved psoriatic and ulcerative skin lesions within a month, with relapse on stopping and improvement on restarting, yet with no fall in the interferon signature. In mice carrying the human R822Q variant, tofacitinib reduced cytokine production and prevented death after a double-stranded RNA challenge. Off label; no data on neurological outcomes.

evidence.reference_title: Short-term efficacy of tofacitinib, a JAK inhibitor, in IFIH1-related Aicardi-Goutières syndrome.
evidence.snippet: After nearly one year, the patient showed no significant disease activity and normal hair growth, with no notable changes in thyroid function.

nodes.description: Mutant MDA5 triggers type I interferon production without infection. Every variant tested in the largest cohort raised interferon signaling, including variants that prediction tools called benign, and serum interferon-alpha is raised in patients.

nodes.description: Type I interferons bind the IFNAR1/IFNAR2 receptor. In three mouse models of constitutively active MDA5, deleting the receptor prevents the lupus-like, cardiac and bone disease, so the receptor is a required step. It is the target of receptor-blocking antibodies, none of which has been reported in a patient with an IFIH1 variant.

nodes.description: Zebrafish line overexpressing ifih1 with the residue equivalent to the human R779H variant. Larvae mount systemic inflammation and an interferon signature after a sub-threshold poly(I:C) stimulus; the response is abolished by knocking down mavs or ikbke, and reduced by baricitinib. Built for high-throughput drug screening.
